scope: Page264 review tabs, tiszafa before-after and Nordmann carousel only.

browser_policy.required: interaction-capable browser with source and target
browser_policy.reuse: one source tab + one target tab only
browser_policy.reason: Preserve Opera memory and avoid mixing state from concurrently repurposed tabs.

preconditions: Fresh target URL must be page264, not a tab repurposed by another process.
Page264 saved-data hash must be reconciled with the accepted live baseline before attributing a new failure to runtime code.
Review static AX contract must still expose three real tabs plus source-equivalent previous/next only; numbered ID14 dots must remain absent from AX/focus on page264.
Tiszafa control must still be native input[type=range] min=0 max=100 step=1 value=50 with data-af-ba-init=1.
Nordmann static control names must still match source previous/next + dots 1-6.

owners.shared: Code Snippets ID14 AF reusable reviews controls v005
owners.page264_containment: Code Snippets ID33 AF old trees semantic parity v001

expected_shared_keyboard_contract: ArrowRight and ArrowDown activate/focus the next real role=tab, wrapping after the third.
ArrowLeft and ArrowUp activate/focus the previous real role=tab, wrapping before the first.
Home activates/focuses the first real tab.
End activates/focuses the last real tab.
page264_specific_invariants: Exactly three real tabs remain keyboard-addressable.
Previous/next controls remain available with source-equivalent accessible names.
.af-review-source-dot elements may remain visually/pointer-active but have tabindex=-1 and aria-hidden=true after ID33 applies.
No duplicate review label or duplicate tablist name appears after any tab change.
test_sequence: Focus real tab 1; ArrowRight -> tab 2; ArrowRight -> tab 3; ArrowRight -> tab 1.
From tab 2 Home -> tab 1; End -> tab 3.
Repeat vertical ArrowDown/ArrowUp if ID14 remains the current owner; expected behavior mirrors right/left.
Activate source-style previous and next controls and verify selected real tab/panel stays synchronized.
After each change, inspect AX/focusables to ensure numbered dots did not re-enter the accessibility tree.
review_tabs.failure_response: Diagnose current ID14/ID33 live bodies and event ownership before changing anything. Never add a second review handler.

accepted_initial_state.before_alt: Az 50+ éves tiszafa a beavatkozás előtt
accepted_initial_state.after_alt: Ugyanaz a tiszafa a formázás után: többszintes niwaki

tiszafa_before_after.source_contract: The source interaction handler listens to input on the native range and sets --ba-pos to value + '%'.
test_sequence: At initial load require value 50 and visual split 50%.
Keyboard ArrowRight once -> value 51 and --ba-pos 51%; ArrowLeft -> back to 50.
Keyboard Home/End may follow native browser range semantics; do not add custom handlers if native behavior is source-equivalent.
Pointer drag to a clearly different position; require native value and visual split to move together.
Return to 50 and confirm alt text/accessible name did not change or duplicate.
tiszafa_before_after.failure_response: First prove whether the existing source-interaction owner is absent, duplicated or losing a CSS variable. Do not replace the native range or add a parallel slider library.

source_runtime_contract.reduced_motion: autoplay disabled while prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; change listener re-evaluates start/stop

test_sequence_normal_motion: Record selected slide/counter at t0 after a stable load.
Without hover/focus, sample after >4.1s and require one forward advance; sample another >4.1s later and require another forward advance.
Press ArrowRight -> exactly one forward advance; ArrowLeft -> exactly one backward advance.
Pointer swipe horizontally by >40px with vertical delta smaller than horizontal -> exactly one direction-appropriate advance.
Pointer movement <40px or vertically dominant movement -> no slide change.
While mouseenter is held across >4.1s, require no autoplay advance; after mouseleave require autoplay to resume.
While focus remains inside across >4.1s, require no autoplay advance; after focus leaves require autoplay to resume.
test_sequence_reduced_motion: Enable prefers-reduced-motion: reduce before/reload or through supported emulation.
Observe >8.2s with no manual action; require no autoplay advance.
Manual ArrowLeft/ArrowRight and pointer controls must remain functional.
If the browser can switch the media query live, toggle preference and require the runtime to re-evaluate autoplay without duplicate timers.
nordmann_carousel.failure_response: Inspect the current live interaction owner and initialization marker before any JS write. Never add a second timer/keyboard/swipe layer merely to satisfy the test.

cross_component_regression_checks: No test action may change visible copy, page264 Elementor data, review accessible labels, form semantics or v004/v005/v006/v007 visual ownership.
No duplicate MutationObserver, timer or keyboard listener may be introduced as a test workaround.
Do not leave autoplay tabs running while testing unrelated sections; keep only the active source/target pair.
No SMTP or form submission is part of this interaction package.
pass_definition: All three components complete their sequences with source-equivalent observable behavior and no new AX/focus or visual regression. A PASS is runtime acceptance only and does not imply PIXEL_PASS.
current_execution_status: PREPARED_NOT_RUN: current Opera connector is disconnected and exposes no generic click/keyboard action when connected; WPVibe is unavailable. No runtime write is justified from this limitation.
